description: This file defines API interaction functions for a frontend web application, including functions to perform GET and POST requests, fetch work items, and create new work items related to project management or issue tracking.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by project_id.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug) using backend API.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Returns the full URL for the given API path using the current base.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
